claimParams.againstWhom: any reader of the verifier output — end users, auditors, downstream relying parties who inherit the overclaim
claimParams.forHowLong: for as long as the output text is displayed, logged, or quoted
claimParams.alongsideWhat: the §9 "must not infer" register and the §24 prohibited-claims list the text is linted against (lint list v0, English only — §27.4 shared artefact)

inputs.verifierOutput: Scoped reuse detection within this context: a repeated nullifier under the same context, scope, purpose, and epoch indicates reuse of one enrolled secret; nothing is established beyond this scope, and a repeat may be a legitimate retry — see the challenge route.
